CONF_A.panel: minimum mandatory: 1 data seed x 2 NP training seeds x 12 toys = 24 NPs (the full 48-NP panel with a second data seed is NOT run in this wave)
CONF_A.seed_checks: historical outputs use data seeds 20261006 (C) / 20261028 (CR) and train/split seed 31 only (all 38 outputs/nn config.json files); numpy SeedSequence accepts the ids
CONF_A.generator: models/s1_generate.py + s2_precheck.py UNCHANGED, run through wave4/conf_pipeline.py with the output ROOT redirected to OUT/confirmation/D<seed>/; design seed 20261023, precheck seed 20261006, 8000 subjects, documented trial counts / priors / noise
CONF_A.bank: CR3 / CR5 (and CR3L / CR5L) reuse the fixed 500-row bank: byte-identical copy into the isolated root, sha256 recorded
CONF_A.noise: the <MODEL>L observation noise stream is the generator's fixed per-model constant (unchanged code); with new T / X the noise attaches to new trials
CONF_A.pairing: <MODEL> and <MODEL>L of one data seed share T / trial counts / X / true logit (generator design), they are not independent formula families
CONF_A.training: nn/s3_train.py UNCHANGED: per-toy latent dim and beta of the Lab 07 toy registry (classic B .0005, C per registry), default stopping rule (500/50 choice, 5000/50 logit), split seed 31, repeat 1, new train seed; S5 Z from all observed trials; S8 / S8_2 supervised references fitted on TRAIN subjects
CONF_A.stage_A: every attempted NP kept in the denominator; Stage A (linear R2 of T on Z, TEST) reported descriptively, never used to drop / regenerate a run
CONF_A.order: register -> generate -> train (may run while development continues; no confirmation file is read by any development step) -> algorithm lock -> blind runs of the locked rule + controls (truth-free payloads) -> hash all blind outputs into confirmation_locks.csv -> only then T / R* evaluation
CONF_A.controls: W3-Q01 lock (RW-GL Q01 S9) and E02 Q01 S9_2, same seeds
CONF_A.aggregation: by toy (family x class) and NP training seed; integration / search seeds are not replicates
